description: Repairs r-expr-1b/conv-text-to-floating and r-par-1/fold-currency-argument-forms: CDec answered 3075 in every form tried and no probe discriminates its argument forms. Asks how CDec binds with zero to three arguments, as [CDec], VBA.CDec and [VBA].[CDec], over literals, stored Vals columns (M, C, D, L, T, N) and declared and undeclared QueryDef parameters (Currency, IEEEDouble, Long, Text), with CCur, CDbl, CSng, CLng, CInt and CByte (right and wrong argument counts) as controls. Each form is its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
